qualification.details: Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical): Post-Graduation degree, including the integrated PG degree, in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university with at least five (5) years of post-qualification experience in RNA Biology (Life Sciences Research) in a recognized lab. Ph.D. with at least two (2) years post-qualification experience in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university. First Class Graduate degree of Four Years in Biotechnology Engineering with at least five (5) years of post-graduation experience.

selection_process: Screening based on applications Online Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IISER Bhopal Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IISER Bhopal to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IISER Bhopal Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) post at IISER Bhopal is 23rd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post-Graduation degree in Life Sciences with 5 years of experience, or a Ph.D. with 2 years of experience, or a First Class Graduate degree in Biotechnology Engineering with 5 years of experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is not completed 45 years of age. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 78,000/- per month plus 20% HRA, totaling Rs. 93,600/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the provided Google Form link before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening of applications followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based recruitment, meaning the position is for a specific project duration.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IISER Bhopal located?
faq.answer: IISER Bhopal is located in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 462066.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with a Biotechnology Engineering background apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a First Class Graduate degree in Biotechnology Engineering and at least 5 years of post-graduation experience are eligible.
